thread:
maya: Kicking off a mini canary for model v5q1 (5% traffic) — want to sync on auto-fallback thresholds and a watchlist for slices.
aj: Noted. Quick telemetry: 10k requests so far, p95 up ~120ms vs baseline, error rate 0.08%, MRR drop 2.4% on the longdoc slices.
zara: Oof 2.4% MRR is higher than I'd expect for a quiet burn. Do we have span-level breakdown? which slices showing worst?
maya: Longform summaries + code-assist prompts are the main regressions. Short chat looks fine.
samir: Suggestion: require both a quality delta and either latency or error spike to trigger auto-fallback. Otherwise we'll flip on noise.
kevin: Agreed. Propose rules:
```
canary: v5q1
traffic: 5%
fallback_policy:
  - condition: quality_delta >= 1.5% AND (p95 >= 100ms OR error_rate >= 0.5%)
  - window: 5m
  - hysteresis: require 3 consecutive windows
  - fallback_target: v5q0.9
```
maya: That config looks reasonable. Two tweaks: lower quality_delta to 1.25% for longdoc slices, and make the window 3m for rapid rollback but keep hysteresis 3 windows.
aj: If we lower delta we need stronger slice guards. I recommend a watchlist of three critical slices: longdoc, code-assist, and rerank. If any of those breach, treat as weighted signal.
zara: How about weightings: longdoc 0.5, code-assist 0.3, rerank 0.2. Then compute weighted_quality_delta. Auto-fallback if weighted >= 1.25%.
samir: Also add minimum sample size: trigger only if sample_count >= 200 in the window. Avoid tiny-sample false positives.
kevin: Ops note: fallback_target should be the last-known-stable pinned variant (v5q0.9) and route weight cutover 100% once fallback flips. Can we also add a soft-degrade path to 50% if signals marginal?
maya: Yes—soft-degrade if weighted in [0.9%,1.25%) for 2 windows -> reduce to 50% for 10m and monitor.
aj: One more: add a manual override label and auto-notify #eng-ml and oncall when fallback happens.
deploy-bot: canary-start: v5q1 -> 5% traffic started at ts=1793334444
kevin: Implementation checklist for SRE:
- metric: weighted_quality_delta (per slice weights)
- metric: p95 latency and error_rate (global + per-slice)
- rule engine: multi-condition with hysteresis + min-samples
- actions: soft-degrade -> hard-fallback -> notify -> rollback marker in deployment log
- audit: persist trigger windows and raw samples for postmortem

zara: I ran a quick eval: 30k synthetic longdocs, v5q1 winrate vs v5q0.9 = 47.8% (so -2.2% absolute). That maps to ~1.8 weighted delta with current slice weights.
maya: Thanks — that supports conservative rollback threshold. Let's lock the config: weighted_threshold=1.25%, min_samples=200, p95_threshold=100ms, error_threshold=0.5%, hysteresis=3 windows of 3m. Soft-degrade range [0.9%,1.25%) -> 50% traffic for 10m.
aj: I'll draft the rollout policy and add to the canary YAML. Also adding a watchlist tag to the model so product & trust can follow.
samir: Can you also enable per-customer slicing for the watchlist so we can see top-10 customers impacted? Helpful for support.
kevin: I'll wire up the alerting: Pager if hard-fallback occurs, but soft-degrade only pages if sustained >30m.
maya: Quick Q: do we want an automatic promote if metrics are _better_ beyond some positive threshold? (eg weighted_delta <= -1.5% for 30m)
azara: I'd be cautious — promotion should require human review. We can auto-escalate to a fast-track review channel but not promote fully.
kevin: Agreed. Auto-promote is risky. Auto-alert + quick manual review = good compromise.
maya: OK team — finalizing config now and will push the canary YAML in 10m. Please thumbs-up below if you agree. :thumbsup:
